---
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: pdflatex
header-includes:
  # assumes preamble.sty is in parent folder
  - \usepackage[useHeader]{../preamble}
  
  - \def\docAuthor{author}
  - \def\docTitle{title}
  - \def\docClass{class}
  - \def\docTerm{term/semester}
  - \def\docDate{\today}
  
  - \lhead{\docAuthor}
  - \chead{\docTitle}
  - \rhead{\docClass}
  
  # nice (?) math font that fixed \neq
  - \usepackage{newtxmath}
  
  # may be able to fix python errors by
  ## 1. downgrading to python=3.10
  ## 2. downgrading to matplotlib=3.8
  ## 3. downgrading to libtiff=4.5.1
  ## 4. downgrading to pillow=10.0.0
---

\thispagestyle{empty} <!-- no header on title page -->
\titlebox{\docClass}{\docTerm}{\docTitle}{\docAuthor}{\docDate}
